subject: Post-call: buying steps, econ advocate & procurement runbook
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.com>; Chris Weber <c.weber@healthsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: buying steps, econ advocate & procurement runbook

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call (30m):
- Primary value: reduce inference cost by ~35% for your nightly batch/real-time mix while keeping 95th pct latency under 120ms.
- Target workload owners: ML infra (Chris), Product (Elena), Procurement (unnamed), Security (TBD).
- Decision criteria called out: total cost of ownership (3yr), data residency, SOC2 evidence, and POC success on throughput under modeled load.

Stakeholder notes we captured:
- Economic buyer: Elena Morales (confirmed) — final sign-off on spend and onboarding timeline.
- Advocate / technical sponsor: Chris Weber — owns performance acceptance criteria.
- Security contact: please loop in the person who owns 3rd-party security assessments; Elena mentioned this sits in Security & Compliance team.
- Procurement lead: awaiting name & process (Elena said there is a standard RFP + questionnaire).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft attached (Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.pdf):
- Week 0: Alignment call (done) + confirm procurement contact and security reviewer.
- Week 1: Share SOC2 summary & answer questionnaire (we will fill preliminary answers).
- Week 2–3: POC kick-off (30-day technical POC, Redwood provides dedicated support & stage).
- Week 4: Performance & cost review; decision checkpoint with Elena (economic) + Chris (technical).
- Week 5: Procurement/contracting window; finalize SOW and billing terms.

Asks for HealthSync this week: 
1) Please share the procurement contact + procurement questionnaire (if different from the one you mentioned).
2) Security point of contact for SOC2 and network/infrastructure questions.
3) Target date for POC start (we suggested 2–3 weeks after questionnaire completion).

Internal notes to Rishi / Marcus: Marcus can you draft the POC runbook and hold a 45-min prep with Chris once we have procurement timelines. Rishi — I put you on the thread to help accelerate contract/discount guidance if needed.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
From: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Weber <c.weber@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: buying steps, econ advocate & procurement runbook

Monica — thanks for the clear recap. Couple of clarifications and I attached our standard procurement questionnaire (HealthSync_procurement_questionnaire.xlsx).

Clarifications:
- Procurement lead: Sarah Newton (sarah.newton@healthsync.com) — she owns vendor setup and commercial terms. cc'd procurement alias above.
- Security reviewer: Chris will introduce me to our security lead (Aisha Khatri) this week; expect a short questionnaire focused on data handling and network access.
- Timeline: procurement will need approx 2 weeks to review the questionnaire once you return it with preliminary answers. Our internal calendar: we are aiming to start POC the week of May 3 if we can get procurement paperwork done by Apr 27.

Questions from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a short POC SOW (scope + acceptance criteria) that we can share with procurement?
- Does Redwood have a standard data handling addendum or is that included in the contract?

I accepted the MAP doc and will circle back with Sarah on contracting windows.

Elena
Director, Product | HealthSync
elena@healthsync.com | 212-555-0302

Attachment: HealthSync_procurement_questionnaire.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: buying steps, econ advocate & procurement runbook

Nice recap, Monica. Quick internal plan and what we should prep before we send the questionnaire back: 

1) POC SOW (Marcus) — include explicit acceptance criteria that match Chris's perf targets (95th <120ms at X QPS, sustained burst behavior). Add required logs/metrics traces Redwood will deliver.
2) Preliminary procurement answers (Monica/Me) — we'll prefill the questionnaire where we can; we'll flag items that require legal review (data addendum, indemnities).
3) SOC2 & security evidence (Marcus) — attach our SOC2-summary.pdf and call out encryption, KMS, and customer audit options.

Timing: I can review prefilled questionnaire by Thu 15 Apr EOD. Marcus — can you have first SOW draft by Thu COB? Monica — once we have both we send to Elena + Sarah and request procurement's preferred contract template.

Also, recommend we offer a small early-adopter credit for a signed POC contract (e.g., 20% off POC usage) to help speed procurement — want to align on approval before we propose.

Rishi
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.com>, Sarah Newton <sarah.newton@healthsync.com>, Chris Weber <c.weber@healthsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & POC SOW (draft) — request for dates and procurement template

Hi Elena / Sarah — attaching our updated MAP and a first-pass POC SOW (linked). Changes since the earlier draft: 
- Added explicit acceptance criteria per Chris's notes; included token-level cost estimate for modeled workload.
- Filled out procurement questionnaire with preliminary answers (see attached sheet in Drive).
- Proposed timeline aligned to your target: POC start week of 3 May; procurement review window Apr 19–27.

Please confirm: 
- Sarah — is the Apr 27 procurement completion target feasible? If not, please propose your preferred date.
- Chris — can we lock the perf target for the SOW as 95th <120ms at 150 QPS (burst 300 QPS) ?
- Elena — if POC start needs to shift, what's the latest date that still aligns with your Q3 roadmap decision?

Attachments (also on Drive): Redwood_MAP_draft_v1.pdf, POC_SOW_v1.docx, prefilled_procurement_answers.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Next internal: Rishi will finalize discount language if we offer early-adopter credit; Marcus will own POC runbook and onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Monica
From: Elena Morales <elena@healthsync.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sarah Newton <sarah.newton@healthsync.com>
Cc: Chris Weber <c.weber@healthsync.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & POC SOW (draft) — request for dates and procurement template

Monica — thanks, received and sharing with Sarah & Security. Quick notes: 
- Sarah: procurement confirmed the Apr 27 target is tight but doable if questions are answered by Apr 15; Sarah will send our contract template and mark any non-starters.
- Security: Aisha Khatri will send a short set of network & entitlement questions by EOD Wed. Chris will coordinate.
- POC start: May 3 still looks good on our side.

We’ll respond with any redlines to the SOW by Apr 22. If everything aligns we’ll schedule the POC kickoff for May 3 (30 days).

Elena
